variants.prompt: First, show me the list of supported countries in French. Then, I want to see product categories available in the United Arab Emirates since I heard they offer the most currency options. Finally, I'm looking for swimwear - can you show me auto-complete suggestions for "bikini top" in the US store using USD currency? I'd like to browse an international shopping site.
